2194a186b0551634df2d0d7e6c1b02c724f21dd3.summary: Check Point Research describes Volant Manticore, a previously undocumented Iran-nexus group. It links the group to MOIS with medium confidence and assesses that it likely consists of former MuddyWater operators. Activity from July 2026 traced back to September 2025 targeted a Cyprus-based airline with a fake CV lure, then shifted in September 2026 toward Saudi healthcare organisations. Tools named include the KuboShell backdoor, which uses IPFS for command and control, the Homa Framework, and NetLock and N-able RMM tools.

hedges: The MOIS link is made with medium confidence; the report has high confidence only that the group is Iran-nexus.
The report cannot rule out that the group now operates under a different Iranian entity, since Iran's cyber ecosystem is fluid.
The former-MuddyWater-operators explanation is assessed with medium confidence and is not proven.
Overlaps with MuddyWater are assessed to reflect shared operational history rather than ongoing collaboration.
The report cannot determine whether the Saudi shift reflects broader tasking or simply multiple lures sent in quick succession.
The third-stage backdoor is assessed to execute additional modules, which the report was unable to recover.
